phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: Monocrystalline silicon PV modules dominate global solar panel production with an estimated market share over 80% as of 2024, due to their high efficiency (20-22%) and cost-effective manufacturing processes, making them the industry standard for utility and residential solar installations.

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover
components.reasoning: The tempered glass cover is a standard protective layer that shields the solar cells from environmental damage and mechanical impact; it is procured as a distinct, manufactured component and is universally used.

components.name: Aluminum Frame
components.reasoning: The aluminum frame provides structural rigidity and mounting capability; it is a separately manufactured assembly common to almost all conventional panel designs to facilitate installation and durable outdoor exposure.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (EVA or POE Film)
components.reasoning: Encapsulation films encapsulate the solar cells to protect them from moisture and mechanical stresses; these film sheets are typically separately procured and laminated into the module during assembly.

components.name: Backsheet
components.reasoning: The backsheet is a polymer layer that insulates and protects the rear of the solar panel from moisture and UV degradation, usually provided as a separate manufactured sheet for lamination.

components.name: Junction Box
components.reasoning: The junction box houses the electrical connections and bypass diodes; it is an electrical subassembly procured separately and attached to the module to facilitate wiring and maintenance.

components.name: Mounting Rail System
components.reasoning: Mounting rails are extruded aluminum structural components used to support and secure solar panels on roofs or ground mounts; these are standard procurable items within the panel installation supply chain.

components.name: Module Frame Gaskets and Seals
components.reasoning: Gaskets and seals are manufactured polymer components used to prevent water ingress between the frame and glass; while small, they are distinct parts procured separately to ensure panel longevity.
